access_request_institution_check.name: access_request_institution_check
access_request_institution_check.value: "access_request"."role" <> 'INSTITUTION' OR ("access_request"."organisation" IS NOT NULL AND "access_request"."scopeAcknowledgedAt" IS NOT NULL)

access_request_mentor_check.name: access_request_mentor_check
access_request_mentor_check.value: "access_request"."role" <> 'MENTOR' OR ("access_request"."organisation" IS NULL AND "access_request"."organisationRole" IS NULL AND "access_request"."scopeAcknowledgedAt" IS NULL)

access_request_message_check.name: access_request_message_check
access_request_message_check.value: "access_request"."decisionMessage" IS NULL OR ("access_request"."status" IN ('APPROVED','DECLINED') AND length(trim("access_request"."decisionMessage")) > 0 AND length("access_request"."decisionMessage") <= 600)

channel_slug_check.name: channel_slug_check
channel_slug_check.value: length("channel"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "channel"."slug" GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND "channel"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "channel"."slug" NOT GLOB '*-'

channel_message_tembo_check.name: channel_message_tembo_check
channel_message_tembo_check.value: "channel_message"."authorKind" = 'USER' OR ("channel_message"."authorId" IS NULL AND "channel_message"."parentId" IS NOT NULL)

channel_message_nonce_check.name: channel_message_nonce_check
channel_message_nonce_check.value: "channel_message"."clientNonce" IS NULL OR (length("channel_message"."clientNonce") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "channel_message"."clientNonce" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*')

channel_message_body_check.name: channel_message_body_check
channel_message_body_check.value: length("channel_message"."body") <= 10000 AND ("channel_message"."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL OR length(trim("channel_message"."body", ' ' || char(9, 10, 13))) > 0)

channel_message_hidden_check.name: channel_message_hidden_check
channel_message_hidden_check.value: ("channel_message"."moderationState" = 'HIDDEN') = ("channel_message"."hiddenAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("channel_message"."hiddenBy" IS NULL OR "channel_message"."moderationState" = 'HIDDEN')

channel_message_time_check.name: channel_message_time_check
channel_message_time_check.value: "channel_message"."createdAt" >= 0 AND coalesce("channel_message"."editedAt", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("channel_message"."deletedAt", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("channel_message"."hiddenAt", 0) >= 0

member_onboarding_done_check.name: member_onboarding_done_check
member_onboarding_done_check.value: "member_onboarding"."stage" = 'DONE' OR ("member_onboarding"."completedAt" IS NULL AND "member_onboarding"."promptDismissedAt" IS NULL)
